name: IN-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+21 partisan lean strongly favors Democrats
Incumbent André Carson running with over $620k cash on hand
Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Carson at 96-97% to win
model.rationale: The district's D+21 lean, Carson's incumbency and strong fundraising against an underfunded challenger, and markets pricing him near 97% all point to a safe Democratic hold. No polls or expert ratings exist, but fundamentals leave little doubt.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention on the Republican side is the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Indianapolis-based IN-07 is a heavily Democratic district, with a partisan lean of D+21. André Carson, the incumbent, is running for another term and has raised over $1 million with more than $620,000 on hand. His Republican opponent, Patrick McAuley, shows no reported fundraising, and a Libertarian is also on the ballot. No general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Carson's chances at roughly 96-97 percent. With the incumbent well-funded, the challenger invisible financially, and the district's strong Democratic tilt, this seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands in November.
